infill_enable_travel_optimization.label: Infill Travel Optimization

draft_shield_height.label: Draft Shield Height
draft_shield_height.description: Height limitation of the draft shield. Above this height no draft shield will be printed.

wireframe_roof_outer_delay.label: WP Roof Outer Delay
wireframe_roof_outer_delay.description: Time spent at the outer perimeters of hole which is to become a roof. Longer times can ensure a better connection. Only applies to Wire Printing.

bridge_skin_density_3.description: The density of the third bridge skin layer. Values less than 100 will increase the gaps between the skin lines.
bridge_skin_density_3.label: Bridge Third Skin Density

conical_overhang_enabled.label: Make Overhang Printable
conical_overhang_enabled.description: Change the geometry of the printed model such that minimal support is required. Steep overhangs will become shallow overhangs. Overhanging areas will drop down to become more vertical.

wireframe_flow_flat.label: WP Flat Flow
wireframe_flow_flat.description: Flow compensation when printing flat lines. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_flow_connection.label: WP Connection Flow
wireframe_flow_connection.description: Flow compensation when going up or down. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_flow.label: WP Flow
wireframe_flow.description: Flow compensation: the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value. Only applies to Wire Printing.

spaghetti_max_height.description: The maximum height of inside space which can be combined and filled from the top.
spaghetti_max_height.label: Spaghetti Infill Maximum Height

flow_rate_extrusion_offset_factor.label: Flow rate compensation factor
flow_rate_extrusion_offset_factor.description: The multiplication factor for the flow rate -> distance translation.

coasting_speed.description: The speed by which to move during coasting, relative to the speed of the extrusion path. A value slightly under 100% is advised, since during the coasting move the pressure in the bowden tube drops.
coasting_speed.label: Coasting Speed

bridge_wall_coast.description: This controls the distance the extruder should coast immediately before a bridge wall begins. Coasting before the bridge starts can reduce the pressure in the nozzle and may produce a flatter bridge.
bridge_wall_coast.label: Bridge Wall Coasting

spaghetti_inset.description: The offset from the walls from where the spaghetti infill will be printed.
spaghetti_inset.label: Spaghetti Inset

meshfix_maximum_deviation.description: The maximum deviation allowed when reducing the resolution for the Maximum Resolution setting. If you increase this, the print will be less accurate, but the g-code will be smaller. Maximum Deviation is a limit for Maximum Resolution, so if the two conflict the Maximum Deviation will always be held true.
meshfix_maximum_deviation.label: Maximum Deviation

wireframe_fall_down.label: WP Fall Down
wireframe_fall_down.description: Distance with which the material falls down after an upward extrusion. This distance is compensated for. Only applies to Wire Printing.

bridge_wall_speed.label: Bridge Wall Speed
bridge_wall_speed.description: The speed at which the bridge walls are printed.

cross_infill_pocket_size.label: Cross 3D Pocket Size
cross_infill_pocket_size.description: The size of pockets at four-way crossings in the cross 3D pattern at heights where the pattern is touching itself.

wipe_move_distance.description: The distance to move the head back and forth across the brush.
wipe_move_distance.label: Wipe Move Distance

support_tree_enable.description: Generate a tree-like support with branches that support your print. This may reduce material usage and print time, but greatly increases slicing time.
support_tree_enable.label: Tree Support

spaghetti_infill_enabled.description: Print the infill every so often, so that the filament will curl up chaotically inside the object. This reduces print time, but the behaviour is rather unpredictable.
spaghetti_infill_enabled.label: Spaghetti Infill

wipe_brush_pos_x.description: X location where wipe script will start.
wipe_brush_pos_x.label: Wipe Brush X Position

support_tree_branch_distance.description: How far apart the branches need to be when they touch the model. Making this distance small will cause the tree support to touch the model at more points, causing better overhang but making support harder to remove.
support_tree_branch_distance.label: Tree Support Branch Distance

wipe_hop_speed.label: Wipe Hop Speed
wipe_hop_speed.description: Speed to move the z-axis during the hop.

wireframe_top_delay.label: WP Top Delay
wireframe_top_delay.description: Delay time after an upward move, so that the upward line can harden. Only applies to Wire Printing.

bridge_fan_speed_2.description: Percentage fan speed to use when printing the second bridge skin layer.
bridge_fan_speed_2.label: Bridge Second Skin Fan Speed

spaghetti_infill_extra_volume.description: A correction term to adjust the total volume being extruded each time when filling spaghetti.
spaghetti_infill_extra_volume.label: Spaghetti Infill Extra Volume

adaptive_layer_height_variation_step.description: The difference in height of the next layer height compared to the previous one.
adaptive_layer_height_variation_step.label: Adaptive Layers Variation Step Size

material_flow_dependent_temperature.description: Change the temperature for each layer automatically with the average flow speed of that layer.
material_flow_dependent_temperature.label: Auto Temperature

magic_fuzzy_skin_point_dist.label: Fuzzy Skin Point Distance
magic_fuzzy_skin_point_dist.description: The average distance between the random points introduced on each line segment. Note that the original points of the polygon are discarded, so a high smoothness results in a reduction of the resolution. This value must be higher than half the Fuzzy Skin Thickness.

magic_fuzzy_skin_point_density.label: Fuzzy Skin Density
magic_fuzzy_skin_point_density.description: The average density of points introduced on each polygon in a layer. Note that the original points of the polygon are discarded, so a low density results in a reduction of the resolution.

roofing_angles.description: A list of integer line directions to use when the top surface skin layers use the lines or zig zag pattern. Elements from the list are used sequentially as the layers progress and when the end of the list is reached, it starts at the beginning again. The list items are separated by commas and the whole list is contained in square brackets. Default is an empty list which means use the traditional default angles (45 and 135 degrees).
roofing_angles.label: Top Surface Skin Line Directions

coasting_enable.description: Coasting replaces the last part of an extrusion path with a travel path. The oozed material is used to print the last piece of the extrusion path in order to reduce stringing.
coasting_enable.label: Enable Coasting

bridge_skin_speed.label: Bridge Skin Speed
bridge_skin_speed.description: The speed at which bridge skin regions are printed.

draft_shield_enabled.description: This will create a wall around the model, which traps (hot) air and shields against exterior airflow. Especially useful for materials which warp easily.
draft_shield_enabled.label: Enable Draft Shield

support_tree_collision_resolution.label: Tree Support Collision Resolution
support_tree_collision_resolution.description: Resolution to compute collisions with to avoid hitting the model. Setting this lower will produce more accurate trees that fail less often, but increases slicing time dramatically.

coasting_min_volume.description: The smallest volume an extrusion path should have before allowing coasting. For smaller extrusion paths, less pressure has been built up in the bowden tube and so the coasted volume is scaled linearly. This value should always be larger than the Coasting Volume.
coasting_min_volume.label: Minimum Volume Before Coasting

adaptive_layer_height_threshold.description: Threshold whether to use a smaller layer or not. This number is compared to the tan of the steepest slope in a layer.
adaptive_layer_height_threshold.label: Adaptive Layers Threshold

cross_infill_density_image.description: The file location of an image of which the brightness values determine the minimal density at the corresponding location in the infill of the print.
cross_infill_density_image.label: Cross Infill Density Image

magic_fuzzy_skin_enabled.description: Randomly jitter while printing the outer wall, so that the surface has a rough and fuzzy look.
magic_fuzzy_skin_enabled.label: Fuzzy Skin

bridge_skin_density_2.description: The density of the second bridge skin layer. Values less than 100 will increase the gaps between the skin lines.
bridge_skin_density_2.label: Bridge Second Skin Density

spaghetti_infill_stepped.description: Whether to print spaghetti infill in steps or extrude all the infill filament at the end of the print.
spaghetti_infill_stepped.label: Spaghetti Infill Stepping

wireframe_straight_before_down.label: WP Straighten Downward Lines
wireframe_straight_before_down.description: Percentage of a diagonally downward line which is covered by a horizontal line piece. This can prevent sagging of the top most point of upward lines. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wipe_retraction_extra_prime_amount.description: Some material can ooze away during a wipe travel moves, which can be compensated for here.
wipe_retraction_extra_prime_amount.label: Wipe Retraction Extra Prime Amount

wipe_retraction_amount.label: Wipe Retraction Distance
wipe_retraction_amount.description: Amount to retract the filament so it does not ooze during the wipe sequence.

minimum_polygon_circumference.description: Polygons in sliced layers that have a circumference smaller than this amount will be filtered out. Lower values lead to higher resolution mesh at the cost of slicing time. It is meant mostly for high resolution SLA printers and very tiny 3D models with a lot of details.
minimum_polygon_circumference.label: Minimum Polygon Circumference

cross_support_density_image.description: The file location of an image of which the brightness values determine the minimal density at the corresponding location in the support.
cross_support_density_image.label: Cross Fill Density Image for Support

roofing_pattern.description: The pattern of the top most layers.
roofing_pattern.label: Top Surface Skin Pattern

small_feature_speed_factor_0.description: Small features on the first layer will be printed at this percentage of their normal print speed. Slower printing can help with adhestion and accuracy.
small_feature_speed_factor_0.label: First Layer Speed

wireframe_nozzle_clearance.label: WP Nozzle Clearance
wireframe_nozzle_clearance.description: Distance between the nozzle and horizontally downward lines. Larger clearance results in diagonally downward lines with a less steep angle, which in turn results in less upward connections with the next layer. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wipe_retraction_enable.description: Retract the filament when the nozzle is moving over a non-printed area.
wipe_retraction_enable.label: Wipe Retraction Enable

wireframe_drag_along.label: WP Drag Along
wireframe_drag_along.description: Distance with which the material of an upward extrusion is dragged along with the diagonally downward extrusion. This distance is compensated for. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wall_overhang_speed_factor.description: Overhanging walls will be printed at this percentage of their normal print speed.
wall_overhang_speed_factor.label: Overhanging Wall Speed

magic_fuzzy_skin_thickness.description: The width within which to jitter. It's advised to keep this below the outer wall width, since the inner walls are unaltered.
magic_fuzzy_skin_thickness.label: Fuzzy Skin Thickness

wipe_hop_amount.description: The height difference when performing a Z Hop.
wipe_hop_amount.label: Wipe Z Hop Height

bridge_settings_enabled.description: Detect bridges and modify print speed, flow and fan settings while bridges are printed.
bridge_settings_enabled.label: Enable Bridge Settings

wireframe_bottom_delay.label: WP Bottom Delay
wireframe_bottom_delay.description: Delay time after a downward move. Only applies to Wire Printing.

bridge_wall_material_flow.description: When printing bridge walls, the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value.
bridge_wall_material_flow.label: Bridge Wall Flow

coasting_volume.description: The volume otherwise oozed. This value should generally be close to the nozzle diameter cubed.
coasting_volume.label: Coasting Volume

draft_shield_dist.label: Draft Shield X/Y Distance
draft_shield_dist.description: Distance of the draft shield from the print, in the X/Y directions.

support_skip_some_zags.description: Skip some support line connections to make the support structure easier to break away. This setting is applicable to the Zig Zag support infill pattern.
support_skip_some_zags.label: Break Up Support In Chunks

spaghetti_flow.description: Adjusts the density of the spaghetti infill. Note that the Infill Density only controls the line spacing of the filling pattern, not the amount of extrusion for spaghetti infill.
spaghetti_flow.label: Spaghetti Flow

spaghetti_max_infill_angle.label: Spaghetti Maximum Infill Angle
spaghetti_max_infill_angle.description: The maximum angle w.r.t. the Z axis of the inside of the print for areas which are to be filled with spaghetti infill afterwards. Lowering this value causes more angled parts in your model to be filled on each layer.

conical_overhang_angle.description: The maximum angle of overhangs after the they have been made printable. At a value of 0° all overhangs are replaced by a piece of model connected to the build plate, 90° will not change the model in any way.
conical_overhang_angle.label: Maximum Model Angle

support_tree_wall_count.label: Tree Support Wall Line Count
support_tree_wall_count.description: The number of walls of the branches of tree support. Thicker walls take longer to print but don't fall over as easily.

support_tree_wall_thickness.label: Tree Support Wall Thickness
support_tree_wall_thickness.description: The thickness of the walls of the branches of tree support. Thicker walls take longer to print but don't fall over as easily.

wipe_retraction_retract_speed.label: Wipe Retraction Retract Speed
wipe_retraction_retract_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted during a wipe retraction move.

wipe_retraction_prime_speed.label: Retraction Prime Speed
wipe_retraction_prime_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is primed during a wipe retraction move.

wipe_retraction_speed.label: Wipe Retraction Speed
wipe_retraction_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted and primed during a wipe retraction move.

wireframe_roof_drag_along.label: WP Roof Drag Along
wireframe_roof_drag_along.description: The distance of the end piece of an inward line which gets dragged along when going back to the outer outline of the roof. This distance is compensated for. Only applies to Wire Printing.

adaptive_layer_height_variation.description: The maximum allowed height different from the base layer height.
adaptive_layer_height_variation.label: Adaptive Layers Maximum Variation

bridge_skin_speed_3.label: Bridge Third Skin Speed
bridge_skin_speed_3.description: Print speed to use when printing the third bridge skin layer.

support_tree_angle.label: Tree Support Branch Angle
support_tree_angle.description: The angle of the branches. Use a lower angle to make them more vertical and more stable. Use a higher angle to be able to have more reach.

adaptive_layer_height_enabled.description: Adaptive layers computes the layer heights depending on the shape of the model.
adaptive_layer_height_enabled.label: Use Adaptive Layers

wireframe_height.label: WP Connection Height
wireframe_height.description: The height of the upward and diagonally downward lines between two horizontal parts. This determines the overall density of the net structure. Only applies to Wire Printing.

support_zag_skip_count.label: Support Chunk Line Count
support_zag_skip_count.description: Skip one in every N connection lines to make the support structure easier to break away.

support_skip_zag_per_mm.label: Support Chunk Size
support_skip_zag_per_mm.description: Leave out a connection between support lines once every N millimeter to make the support structure easier to break away.

wireframe_roof_inset.label: WP Roof Inset Distance
wireframe_roof_inset.description: The distance covered when making a connection from a roof outline inward. Only applies to Wire Printing.

material_flow_temp_graph.description: Data linking material flow (in mm3 per second) to temperature (degrees Celsius).
material_flow_temp_graph.label: Flow Temperature Graph

wireframe_roof_fall_down.label: WP Roof Fall Down
wireframe_roof_fall_down.description: The distance which horizontal roof lines printed 'in thin air' fall down when being printed. This distance is compensated for. Only applies to Wire Printing.

small_feature_speed_factor.description: Small features will be printed at this percentage of their normal print speed. Slower printing can help with adhestion and accuracy.
small_feature_speed_factor.label: Small Feature Speed

wireframe_printspeed_up.label: WP Upward Printing Speed
wireframe_printspeed_up.description: Speed of printing a line upward 'in thin air'. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_printspeed_down.label: WP Downward Printing Speed
wireframe_printspeed_down.description: Speed of printing a line diagonally downward. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_printspeed_bottom.label: WP Bottom Printing Speed
wireframe_printspeed_bottom.description: Speed of printing the first layer, which is the only layer touching the build platform. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_printspeed_flat.label: WP Horizontal Printing Speed
wireframe_printspeed_flat.description: Speed of printing the horizontal contours of the model. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_printspeed.label: WP Speed
wireframe_printspeed.description: Speed at which the nozzle moves when extruding material. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wireframe_enabled.description: Print only the outside surface with a sparse webbed structure, printing 'in thin air'. This is realized by horizontally printing the contours of the model at given Z intervals which are connected via upward and diagonally downward lines.
wireframe_enabled.label: Wire Printing

clean_between_layers.description: Whether to include nozzle wipe G-Code between layers. Enabling this setting could influence behavior of retract at layer change. Please use Wipe Retraction settings to control retraction at layers where the wipe script will be working.
clean_between_layers.label: Wipe Nozzle Between Layers

small_feature_max_length.description: Feature outlines that are shorter than this length will be printed using Small Feature Speed.
small_feature_max_length.label: Small Feature Max Length

support_tree_branch_diameter_angle.label: Tree Support Branch Diameter Angle
support_tree_branch_diameter_angle.description: The angle of the branches' diameter as they gradually become thicker towards the bottom. An angle of 0 will cause the branches to have uniform thickness over their length. A bit of an angle can increase stability of the tree support.

wireframe_flat_delay.label: WP Flat Delay
wireframe_flat_delay.description: Delay time between two horizontal segments. Introducing such a delay can cause better adhesion to previous layers at the connection points, while too long delays cause sagging. Only applies to Wire Printing.

slicing_tolerance.description: How to slice layers with diagonal surfaces. The areas of a layer can be generated based on where the middle of the layer intersects the surface (Middle). Alternatively each layer can have the areas which fall inside of the volume throughout the height of the layer (Exclusive) or a layer has the areas which fall inside anywhere within the layer (Inclusive). Exclusive retains the most details, Inclusive makes for the best fit and Middle takes the least time to process.
slicing_tolerance.label: Slicing Tolerance

draft_shield_height_limitation.description: Set the height of the draft shield. Choose to print the draft shield at the full height of the model or at a limited height.
draft_shield_height_limitation.label: Draft Shield Limitation

wireframe_strategy.description: Strategy for making sure two consecutive layers connect at each connection point. Retraction lets the upward lines harden in the right position, but may cause filament grinding. A knot can be made at the end of an upward line to heighten the chance of connecting to it and to let the line cool; however, it may require slow printing speeds. Another strategy is to compensate for the sagging of the top of an upward line; however, the lines won't always fall down as predicted.
wireframe_strategy.label: WP Strategy

wireframe_top_jump.label: WP Knot Size
wireframe_top_jump.description: Creates a small knot at the top of an upward line, so that the consecutive horizontal layer has a better chance to connect to it. Only applies to Wire Printing.

support_conical_enabled.description: Make support areas smaller at the bottom than at the overhang.
support_conical_enabled.label: Enable Conical Support

skin_alternate_rotation.description: Alternate the direction in which the top/bottom layers are printed. Normally they are printed diagonally only. This setting adds the X-only and Y-only directions.
skin_alternate_rotation.label: Alternate Skin Rotation

flow_rate_max_extrusion_offset.label: Flow rate compensation max extrusion offset
flow_rate_max_extrusion_offset.description: The maximum distance in mm to compensate.

max_extrusion_before_wipe.description: Maximum material, that can be extruded before another nozzle wipe is initiated.
max_extrusion_before_wipe.label: Material Volume Between Wipes

bridge_skin_speed_2.label: Bridge Second Skin Speed
bridge_skin_speed_2.description: Print speed to use when printing the second bridge skin layer.

bridge_skin_material_flow.description: When printing bridge skin regions, the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value.
bridge_skin_material_flow.label: Bridge Skin Flow

bridge_skin_support_threshold.description: If a skin region is supported for less than this percentage of its area, print it using the bridge settings. Otherwise it is printed using the normal skin settings.
bridge_skin_support_threshold.label: Bridge Skin Support Threshold

meshfix_maximum_resolution.description: The minimum size of a line segment after slicing. If you increase this, the mesh will have a lower resolution. This may allow the printer to keep up with the speed it has to process g-code and will increase slice speed by removing details of the mesh that it can't process anyway.
meshfix_maximum_resolution.label: Maximum Resolution

bridge_skin_material_flow_3.label: Bridge Third Skin Flow
bridge_skin_material_flow_3.description: When printing the third bridge skin layer, the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value.

bridge_fan_speed_3.description: Percentage fan speed to use when printing the third bridge skin layer.
bridge_fan_speed_3.label: Bridge Third Skin Fan Speed

wipe_repeat_count.description: Number of times to move the nozzle across the brush.
wipe_repeat_count.label: Wipe Repeat Count

wall_overhang_angle.description: Walls that overhang more than this angle will be printed using overhanging wall settings. When the value is 90, no walls will be treated as overhanging.
wall_overhang_angle.label: Overhanging Wall Angle

roofing_line_width.label: Top Surface Skin Line Width
roofing_line_width.description: Width of a single line of the areas at the top of the print.

wireframe_up_half_speed.label: WP Ease Upward
wireframe_up_half_speed.description:
Distance of an upward move which is extruded with half speed.
This can cause better adhesion to previous layers, while not heating the material in those layers too much. Only applies to Wire Printing.

wipe_hop_enable.description: Whenever a retraction is done, the build plate is lowered to create clearance between the nozzle and the print. It prevents the nozzle from hitting the print during travel moves, reducing the chance to knock the print from the build plate.
wipe_hop_enable.label: Wipe Z Hop When Retracted

bridge_wall_min_length.description: Unsupported walls shorter than this will be printed using the normal wall settings. Longer unsupported walls will be printed using the bridge wall settings.
bridge_wall_min_length.label: Minimum Bridge Wall Length

support_conical_min_width.label: Conical Support Minimum Width
support_conical_min_width.description: Minimum width to which the base of the conical support area is reduced. Small widths can lead to unstable support structures.

support_tree_branch_diameter.label: Tree Support Branch Diameter
support_tree_branch_diameter.description: The diameter of the thinnest branches of tree support. Thicker branches are more sturdy. Branches towards the base will be thicker than this.

bridge_skin_density.description: The density of the bridge skin layer. Values less than 100 will increase the gaps between the skin lines.
bridge_skin_density.label: Bridge Skin Density

small_hole_max_size.description: Holes and part outlines with a diameter smaller than this will be printed using Small Feature Speed.
small_hole_max_size.label: Small Hole Max Size

meshfix_maximum_travel_resolution.label: Maximum Travel Resolution
meshfix_maximum_travel_resolution.description: The minimum size of a travel line segment after slicing. If you increase this, the travel moves will have less smooth corners. This may allow the printer to keep up with the speed it has to process g-code, but it may cause model avoidance to become less accurate.

bridge_skin_material_flow_2.label: Bridge Second Skin Flow
bridge_skin_material_flow_2.description: When printing the second bridge skin layer, the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value.

support_conical_angle.label: Conical Support Angle
support_conical_angle.description: The angle of the tilt of conical support. With 0 degrees being vertical, and 90 degrees being horizontal. Smaller angles cause the support to be more sturdy, but consist of more material. Negative angles cause the base of the support to be wider than the top.

bridge_fan_speed.description: Percentage fan speed to use when printing bridge walls and skin.
bridge_fan_speed.label: Bridge Fan Speed

bridge_enable_more_layers.description: If enabled, the second and third layers above the air are printed using the following settings. Otherwise, those layers are printed using the normal settings.
bridge_enable_more_layers.label: Bridge Has Multiple Layers

center_object.description: Whether to center the object on the middle of the build platform (0,0), instead of using the coordinate system in which the object was saved.
center_object.label: Center Object

mesh_position_x.description: Offset applied to the object in the x direction.
mesh_position_x.label: Mesh Position X

mesh_position_y.description: Offset applied to the object in the y direction.
mesh_position_y.label: Mesh Position Y

mesh_rotation_matrix.description: Transformation matrix to be applied to the model when loading it from file.
mesh_rotation_matrix.label: Mesh Rotation Matrix

mesh_position_z.description: Offset applied to the object in the z direction. With this you can perform what was used to be called 'Object Sink'.
mesh_position_z.label: Mesh Position Z

command_line_settings.label: Command Line Settings
command_line_settings.description: Settings which are only used if CuraEngine isn't called from the Cura frontend.

retraction_extrusion_window.label: Minimum Extrusion Distance Window
retraction_extrusion_window.description: The window in which the maximum retraction count is enforced. This value should be approximately the same as the retraction distance, so that effectively the number of times a retraction passes the same patch of material is limited.

default_material_bed_temperature.label: Default Build Plate Temperature
default_material_bed_temperature.description: The default temperature used for the heated build plate. This should be the "base" temperature of a build plate. All other print temperatures should use offsets based on this value

material_bed_temperature_layer_0.label: Build Plate Temperature Initial Layer
material_bed_temperature_layer_0.description: The temperature used for the heated build plate at the first layer.

default_material_print_temperature.label: Default Printing Temperature
default_material_print_temperature.description: The default temperature used for printing. This should be the "base" temperature of a material. All other print temperatures should use offsets based on this value

material_break_speed.description: The speed at which to retract the filament in order to break it cleanly.
material_break_speed.label: Break Retraction Speed

retraction_amount.description: The length of material retracted during a retraction move.
retraction_amount.label: Retraction Distance

material_break_preparation_speed.description: How fast the filament needs to be retracted just before breaking it off in a retraction.
material_break_preparation_speed.label: Break Preparation Retraction Speed

material_final_print_temperature.label: Final Printing Temperature
material_final_print_temperature.description: The temperature to which to already start cooling down just before the end of printing.

material_bed_temperature.label: Build Plate Temperature
material_bed_temperature.description: The temperature used for the heated build plate. If this is 0, the bed temperature will not be adjusted.

material_print_temperature_layer_0.label: Printing Temperature Initial Layer
material_print_temperature_layer_0.description: The temperature used for printing the first layer. Set at 0 to disable special handling of the initial layer.

material_anti_ooze_retracted_position.description: How far the material needs to be retracted before it stops oozing.
material_anti_ooze_retracted_position.label: Anti-ooze Retracted Position

material_initial_print_temperature.label: Initial Printing Temperature
material_initial_print_temperature.description: The minimal temperature while heating up to the Printing Temperature at which printing can already start.

retraction_count_max.description: This setting limits the number of retractions occurring within the minimum extrusion distance window. Further retractions within this window will be ignored. This avoids retracting repeatedly on the same piece of filament, as that can flatten the filament and cause grinding issues.
retraction_count_max.label: Maximum Retraction Count

build_volume_temperature.label: Build Volume Temperature
build_volume_temperature.description: The temperature of the environment to print in. If this is 0, the build volume temperature will not be adjusted.

material_crystallinity.description: Is this material the type that breaks off cleanly when heated (crystalline), or is it the type that produces long intertwined polymer chains (non-crystalline)?
material_crystallinity.label: Crystalline Material

retraction_min_travel.label: Retraction Minimum Travel
retraction_min_travel.description: The minimum distance of travel needed for a retraction to happen at all. This helps to get fewer retractions in a small area.

retract_at_layer_change.description: Retract the filament when the nozzle is moving to the next layer.
retract_at_layer_change.label: Retract at Layer Change

switch_extruder_retraction_speed.label: Nozzle Switch Retract Speed
switch_extruder_retraction_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted during a nozzle switch retract.

switch_extruder_prime_speed.label: Nozzle Switch Prime Speed
switch_extruder_prime_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is pushed back after a nozzle switch retraction.

switch_extruder_retraction_speeds.label: Nozzle Switch Retraction Speed
switch_extruder_retraction_speeds.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted. A higher retraction speed works better, but a very high retraction speed can lead to filament grinding.

retraction_enable.description: Retract the filament when the nozzle is moving over a non-printed area.
retraction_enable.label: Enable Retraction

material_standby_temperature.label: Standby Temperature
material_standby_temperature.description: The temperature of the nozzle when another nozzle is currently used for printing.

material_extrusion_cool_down_speed.label: Extrusion Cool Down Speed Modifier
material_extrusion_cool_down_speed.description: The extra speed by which the nozzle cools while extruding. The same value is used to signify the heat up speed lost when heating up while extruding.

switch_extruder_retraction_amount.label: Nozzle Switch Retraction Distance
switch_extruder_retraction_amount.description: The amount of retraction when switching extruders. Set to 0 for no retraction at all. This should generally be the same as the length of the heat zone.

limit_support_retractions.description: Omit retraction when moving from support to support in a straight line. Enabling this setting saves print time, but can lead to excessive stringing within the support structure.
limit_support_retractions.label: Limit Support Retractions

material_break_temperature.description: The temperature at which the filament is broken for a clean break.
material_break_temperature.label: Break Temperature

skirt_brim_material_flow.label: Skirt/Brim Flow
skirt_brim_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on skirt or brim lines.

prime_tower_flow.label: Prime Tower Flow
prime_tower_flow.description: Flow compensation on prime tower lines.

wall_x_material_flow.label: Inner Wall(s) Flow
wall_x_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on wall lines for all wall lines except the outermost one.

wall_0_material_flow.label: Outer Wall Flow
wall_0_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on the outermost wall line.

support_bottom_material_flow.label: Support Floor Flow
support_bottom_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on support floor lines.

support_roof_material_flow.label: Support Roof Flow
support_roof_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on support roof lines.

support_interface_material_flow.label: Support Interface Flow
support_interface_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on lines of support roof or floor.

support_material_flow.label: Support Flow
support_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on support structure lines.

roofing_material_flow.label: Top Surface Skin Flow
roofing_material_flow.description: Flow compensation on lines of the areas at the top of the print.

material_flow.description: Flow compensation: the amount of material extruded is multiplied by this value.
material_flow.label: Flow

material_anti_ooze_retraction_speed.description: How fast the material needs to be retracted during a filament switch to prevent oozing.
material_anti_ooze_retraction_speed.label: Anti-ooze Retraction Speed

retraction_retract_speed.label: Retraction Retract Speed
retraction_retract_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted during a retraction move.

retraction_prime_speed.label: Retraction Prime Speed
retraction_prime_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is primed during a retraction move.

retraction_speed.label: Retraction Speed
retraction_speed.description: The speed at which the filament is retracted and primed during a retraction move.

material_break_preparation_retracted_pos.description: How far the filament can be stretched before it breaks, while heated.
material_break_preparation_retracted_pos.label: Break Preparation Retracted Position

switch_extruder_extra_prime_amount.description: Extra material to prime after nozzle switching.
switch_extruder_extra_prime_amount.label: Nozzle Switch Extra Prime Amount

retraction_extra_prime_amount.description: Some material can ooze away during a travel move, which can be compensated for here.
retraction_extra_prime_amount.label: Retraction Extra Prime Amount

material_break_retracted_position.description: How far to retract the filament in order to break it cleanly.
material_break_retracted_position.label: Break Retracted Position

material_flow_layer_0.description: Flow compensation for the first layer: the amount of material extruded on the initial layer is multiplied by this value.
material_flow_layer_0.label: Initial Layer Flow

ooze_shield_enabled.description: Enable exterior ooze shield. This will create a shell around the model which is likely to wipe a second nozzle if it's at the same height as the first nozzle.
ooze_shield_enabled.label: Enable Ooze Shield

prime_tower_min_volume.description: The minimum volume for each layer of the prime tower in order to purge enough material.
prime_tower_min_volume.label: Prime Tower Minimum Volume

prime_tower_brim_enable.description: Prime-towers might need the extra adhesion afforded by a brim even if the model doesn't. Presently can't be used with the 'Raft' adhesion-type.
prime_tower_brim_enable.label: Prime Tower Brim

prime_tower_position_y.label: Prime Tower Y Position
prime_tower_position_y.value: =machine_depth - prime_tower_size - max(extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'brim_width') * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 if adhesion_type == 'brim' or (prime_tower_brim_enable and adhesion_type != 'raft') else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'raft_margin') if adhesion_type == 'raft' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'skirt_gap') if adhesion_type == 'skirt' else 0)), max(extruderValues('travel_avoid_distance'))) - max(extruderValues('support_offset')) - sum(extruderValues('skirt_brim_line_width')) * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 - (resolveOrValue('draft_shield_dist') if resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') else 0) - 1
prime_tower_position_y.maximum_value: =machine_depth / 2 - resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size') if machine_center_is_zero else machine_depth - resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size')
prime_tower_position_y.description: The y coordinate of the position of the prime tower.

ooze_shield_dist.label: Ooze Shield Distance
ooze_shield_dist.description: Distance of the ooze shield from the print, in the X/Y directions.

prime_tower_enable.description: Print a tower next to the print which serves to prime the material after each nozzle switch.
prime_tower_enable.label: Enable Prime Tower

ooze_shield_angle.label: Ooze Shield Angle
ooze_shield_angle.description: The maximum angle a part in the ooze shield will have. With 0 degrees being vertical, and 90 degrees being horizontal. A smaller angle leads to less failed ooze shields, but more material.

prime_tower_size.label: Prime Tower Size
prime_tower_size.description: The width of the prime tower.

prime_tower_position_x.label: Prime Tower X Position
prime_tower_position_x.value: =machine_width - max(extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'brim_width') * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 if adhesion_type == 'brim' or (prime_tower_brim_enable and adhesion_type != 'raft') else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'raft_margin') if adhesion_type == 'raft' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'skirt_gap') if adhesion_type == 'skirt' else 0)), max(extruderValues('travel_avoid_distance'))) - max(extruderValues('support_offset')) - sum(extruderValues('skirt_brim_line_width')) * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 - (resolveOrValue('draft_shield_dist') if resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') else 0) - 1
prime_tower_position_x.description: The x coordinate of the position of the prime tower.

prime_tower_wipe_enabled.description: After printing the prime tower with one nozzle, wipe the oozed material from the other nozzle off on the prime tower.
prime_tower_wipe_enabled.label: Wipe Inactive Nozzle on Prime Tower

dual.label: Dual Extrusion
dual.description: Settings used for printing with multiple extruders.

print_sequence.options: OrderedDict([('all_at_once', 'All at Once'), ('one_at_a_time', 'One at a Time')])
print_sequence.description: Whether to print all models one layer at a time or to wait for one model to finish, before moving on to the next. One at a time mode is only possible if all models are separated in such a way that the whole print head can move in between and all models are lower than the distance between the nozzle and the X/Y axes.
print_sequence.label: Print Sequence

infill_mesh_order.label: Infill Mesh Order
infill_mesh_order.description: Determines which infill mesh is inside the infill of another infill mesh. An infill mesh with a higher order will modify the infill of infill meshes with lower order and normal meshes.

smooth_spiralized_contours.description: Smooth the spiralized contours to reduce the visibility of the Z seam (the Z seam should be barely visible on the print but will still be visible in the layer view). Note that smoothing will tend to blur fine surface details.
smooth_spiralized_contours.label: Smooth Spiralized Contours

relative_extrusion.description: Use relative extrusion rather than absolute extrusion. Using relative E-steps makes for easier post-processing of the g-code. However, it's not supported by all printers and it may produce very slight deviations in the amount of deposited material compared to absolute E-steps. Irrespective of this setting, the extrusion mode will always be set to absolute before any g-code script is output.
relative_extrusion.label: Relative Extrusion

anti_overhang_mesh.description: Use this mesh to specify where no part of the model should be detected as overhang. This can be used to remove unwanted support structure.
anti_overhang_mesh.label: Anti Overhang Mesh

support_mesh.description: Use this mesh to specify support areas. This can be used to generate support structure.
support_mesh.label: Support Mesh

mold_enabled.description: Print models as a mold, which can be cast in order to get a model which resembles the models on the build plate.
mold_enabled.label: Mold

magic_spiralize.description: Spiralize smooths out the Z move of the outer edge. This will create a steady Z increase over the whole print. This feature turns a solid model into a single walled print with a solid bottom. This feature should only be enabled when each layer only contains a single part.
magic_spiralize.label: Spiralize Outer Contour

mold_roof_height.description: The height above horizontal parts in your model which to print mold.
mold_roof_height.label: Mold Roof Height

cutting_mesh.description: Limit the volume of this mesh to within other meshes. You can use this to make certain areas of one mesh print with different settings and with a whole different extruder.
cutting_mesh.label: Cutting Mesh

mold_width.description: The minimal distance between the ouside of the mold and the outside of the model.
mold_width.label: Minimal Mold Width

infill_mesh.description: Use this mesh to modify the infill of other meshes with which it overlaps. Replaces infill regions of other meshes with regions for this mesh. It's suggested to only print one Wall and no Top/Bottom Skin for this mesh.
infill_mesh.label: Infill Mesh

magic_mesh_surface_mode.description: Treat the model as a surface only, a volume, or volumes with loose surfaces. The normal print mode only prints enclosed volumes. "Surface" prints a single wall tracing the mesh surface with no infill and no top/bottom skin. "Both" prints enclosed volumes like normal and any remaining polygons as surfaces.
magic_mesh_surface_mode.label: Surface Mode

mold_angle.label: Mold Angle
mold_angle.description: The angle of overhang of the outer walls created for the mold. 0° will make the outer shell of the mold vertical, while 90° will make the outside of the model follow the contour of the model.

cool_lift_head.description: When the minimum speed is hit because of minimum layer time, lift the head away from the print and wait the extra time until the minimum layer time is reached.
cool_lift_head.label: Lift Head

cool_fan_enabled.description: Enables the print cooling fans while printing. The fans improve print quality on layers with short layer times and bridging / overhangs.
cool_fan_enabled.label: Enable Print Cooling

cool_min_layer_time_fan_speed_max.description: The layer time which sets the threshold between regular fan speed and maximum fan speed. Layers that print slower than this time use regular fan speed. For faster layers the fan speed gradually increases towards the maximum fan speed.
cool_min_layer_time_fan_speed_max.label: Regular/Maximum Fan Speed Threshold

cool_fan_full_layer.description: The layer at which the fans spin on regular fan speed. If regular fan speed at height is set, this value is calculated and rounded to a whole number.
cool_fan_full_layer.label: Regular Fan Speed at Layer

cool_fan_full_at_height.description: The height at which the fans spin on regular fan speed. At the layers below the fan speed gradually increases from Initial Fan Speed to Regular Fan Speed.
cool_fan_full_at_height.label: Regular Fan Speed at Height

cool_min_speed.description: The minimum print speed, despite slowing down due to the minimum layer time. When the printer would slow down too much, the pressure in the nozzle would be too low and result in bad print quality.
cool_min_speed.label: Minimum Speed

cool_fan_speed_0.description: The speed at which the fans spin at the start of the print. In subsequent layers the fan speed is gradually increased up to the layer corresponding to Regular Fan Speed at Height.
cool_fan_speed_0.label: Initial Fan Speed

cool_fan_speed_min.label: Regular Fan Speed
cool_fan_speed_min.description: The speed at which the fans spin before hitting the threshold. When a layer prints faster than the threshold, the fan speed gradually inclines towards the maximum fan speed.

cool_fan_speed_max.label: Maximum Fan Speed
cool_fan_speed_max.description: The speed at which the fans spin on the minimum layer time. The fan speed gradually increases between the regular fan speed and maximum fan speed when the threshold is hit.

cool_fan_speed.label: Fan Speed
cool_fan_speed.description: The speed at which the print cooling fans spin.

cool_min_layer_time.description: The minimum time spent in a layer. This forces the printer to slow down, to at least spend the time set here in one layer. This allows the printed material to cool down properly before printing the next layer. Layers may still take shorter than the minimal layer time if Lift Head is disabled and if the Minimum Speed would otherwise be violated.
cool_min_layer_time.label: Minimum Layer Time
